Skirmish with the Orcs (10+)

Start NPC: [Sentinel] Kendnell
Description:
Restrictions:
Repeatable: No
Last Hit: Solo
Reward:
 
1 Red Sunset Sword,
1 Red Sunset Staff


Guide

Step
Description
1
Talk to [Sentinel] Kendnell. He assigns you an orc chief.
2
Kill the assigned chief and retrieve the
1 Kaboo Chief Torque1: [Kaboo Chief] Uoph, [Kaboo Chief] Kracha, [Kaboo Chief] Batoh and [Kaboo Chief] Tanukia
3
Return to [Sentinel] Kendnell with the torc1. He assigns you another chief to kill.
4
Kill the assigned chief and retrieve the
1 Kaboo Chief Torque 2: [Kaboo Chief] Turel, [Kaboo Chief] Roko, [Kaboo Chief] Kamut and [Kaboo Chief] Murtika
5
Return to [Sentinel] Kendnell with the torc2, for a
1 Red Sunset Sword or
1 Red Sunset Staff.


Game Description

Step
Description
1
Recently, Orcs of the Misty Mountains have made several attacks on the Elven Forest. Sentinel Kendell of the Elven Village asks you to drive out the Orcs and become the Guardian of the Forest.
